description: Source code for AndroidModuleConverter1 class, which extends ConversionProcessor to handle module settings conversion related to Android SDK and dependencies within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

classes.name: AndroidModuleConverter1
classes.description: A class extending ConversionProcessor to convert Android module settings, managing dependencies and SDK configurations.

methods.name: isConversionNeeded
methods.description: Checks if the module settings require conversion based on the presence of a specific Android facet configuration.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs the conversion process, updating dependencies and SDK configurations based on the module settings.

methods.name: addNewDependency
methods.description: Adds a new JDK dependency to the module settings based on the provided SDK name.

methods.name: removeOldDependencies
methods.description: Removes outdated library and JDK dependencies from the module settings.
